caption: The drawing features a metallic golden eagle with its wings partially spread and its beak open, facing left. The eagle's feathers, wings, and head are rendered with shades of yellow, gold, and brown, giving a shiny, reflective appearance. The bird is perched on top of a golden spherical object, which appears segmented. The eagle has a prominent eye, depicted using a grayish color, and the inside of its open beak is dark with a touch of bright red. The background of the drawing is blank and off-white, highlighting the central golden eagle and sphere. The artist's signature, "CHRIS MAKERROS," is visible to the lower right of the eagle.
title: Eagle Weather Vane
